name: Shijiazhuang ChangShan BeiMing Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Shijiazhuang ChangShan BeiMing Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the textile, and software and IT services businesses in China and internationally. The company engages in the production and sale of pure cotton and blended yarns; import and export of self-produced products and technologies; and wholesale and retail of cotton.
